purpose: A door page outside my interests. I want to meet something new before the live coding pull starts the day.

pages.title: Always Has Been
pages.reaction: A meme format that has been captioned 255500 times this month, which is a lot of people agreeing with each other about who was lying. Mostly I see a format built for one joke and then reused until it wears thin. Not much here for a tinkerer, though the number itself is the funny part.

pages.title: UNO Draw 25 Cards
pages.reaction: A meme format with 672500 captions in a month, and the top joke is just a card-draw penalty. Nothing here for the live coding pull, but it is a good reminder that repetition can be the whole act. Dull to me, though the captions must be a lot of fun.
